name: antigravity-reviewers
description: Independent second-opinion reviews from Google's Antigravity CLI (agy), using Gemini or any model agy offers (Claude Opus/Sonnet, GPT-OSS). Review code, security, architecture, API/UX design and tests, or documents such as resumes, plans, ideas, reports and presentations together with their context, then triage the feedback and decide together what to change.

interface.shortDescription: Second-opinion reviews of code and documents from agy
interface.longDescription: Ask Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) for an independent review using Gemini, Claude or GPT-OSS models. Covers code, security, architecture, design and tests, plus resumes, plans, ideas, reports and decks with their supporting context. Codex triages the feedback and asks before changing anything.
defaultPrompt: Ask gemini to review my uncommitted changes
Ask opus via agy to review this resume against the job description
